visual_assessment.method: Direct inspection of six-column comparison image; subjective qualitative assessment of two captions at one seed each, 256x256, 50 diffusion steps.

dog_penguin.native_cfg5: Recognizable dog and penguin with blue helmets; desired relation broadly present.
dog_penguin.native_cfg1: Dog and penguin recognizable with distortions; weaker than CFG5.
dog_penguin.prism_cfg1: Coherent room and window; distorted merged figure, no clear second penguin or requested pair.
dog_penguin.prism_native_negative_cfg5: Coherent room, black/white plush-like figure below separate blue object; requested dog/penguin pair and worn helmets not preserved.
dog_penguin.prism_prism_negative_cfg5: Very similar to mixed CFG5, with the same missing/merged subjects; untrained negative anchor.

airplanes.native_cfg5: Two recognizable aircraft, but one airborne although caption describes both on runway.
airplanes.native_cfg1: Runway-like scene and small aircraft/vehicle forms; weaker than CFG5.
airplanes.prism_cfg1: Coherent runway with small ambiguous objects; two recognizable airplanes not established.
airplanes.prism_native_negative_cfg5: Two aircraft-like objects recovered: yellow airborne and blue/purple lower object. Ground-plane identity is distorted; silver color and both-on-runway relation are missed.
airplanes.prism_prism_negative_cfg5: Similar two aircraft-like objects and relational errors; untrained negative anchor.

limits: Flow probes cover eight captions per split at three correlated timesteps, not 24 independent examples.
Near-native aggregate flow loss does not establish generation fidelity. Held-out caption gap remains about 60 percent of native.
Checkpoint bytes stayed on Aurora: this local audit verifies recorded strict restore and collected report identity, not a fresh checkpoint-byte read.
Ordinary diagnostic captures actual noisy-input/timestep equality at each DiT forward; unlike template-swap diagnostic, it does not record conditioning tensor hashes per forward.
Two generated captions at one seed and 256px are qualitative diagnostics only; DOCCI also overlaps original OmniGen2 training sources.

recommendation.short_joint_smoke: Mechanics/timing smoke may be reasonable but should not be called a generation-supported scaling gate.
recommendation.preferred_next_step: Bounded frozen-DiT content intervention: preserve learned aligned prefix/suffix and replace or interpolate only caption-content states toward native teacher states, with exact token partition and actual DiT conditioning/noise controls at CFG1 and matched native-negative CFG5. This tests residual caption-content sensitivity independently of prefix/template repair. Teacher-assisted recovery would remain diagnostic only.
